knownLimitations: number SlotType exists in schema but is never inferred (no provable round-trip neutrality for numeric formatting)
no rich-text/innerHTML slots in V1 - every text occurrence is a leaf text-run binding
page metadata coverage is title-only - reconstruction app renders no description/og:* tags
srcset stripping (stripStaleSrcsets) is a render-time band-aid for 32 channel.io img nodes with bound src but unbound srcset; root fix (emit srcset bindings) not done, inputs frozen
iframe title is classified infrastructure/embed and unslottable (10 occurrences on channel, e.g. Channel chat)
3 provenance surfaces per site carry the source host and are not slotted: route-map.json rootUrl/url, package.json name, generated-config.ts SOURCE_ROOT_URL
repeaters are page-scoped, not merged globally - same nav/footer list on N pages is N separate repeaters
nested repeaters are both kept as definitions but only one level of a nested pair can be driven per render (REPEATER_NESTED_SKIPPED)
likelyGlobal backlog of same-value-outside-header/footer slots not auto-merged: rosee 234, channel 115
realistic content corpus intentionally keeps pure-quantitative text (prices/ranges/units) unchanged - reuses source numbers, not identity
12-hex slot/binding/group/repeater/token ids (~48 bits) - collisions detected and reported (0 measured) but a later duplicate is dropped, not hard-failed
finalVerdict: READY FOR SLOTIZED TEMPLATE HUMAN ACCEPTANCE
